TimeRequired.definition: Time required to produce one batch of part p on machine m

MachineCosts.definition: Cost of operating machine m for one month

Availability.definition: Number of hours machine m is available each month without overtime

Prices.definition: Price received for selling one batch of part p

MinBatches.definition: Minimum number of batches of part p to be produced

StandardCost.definition: Standard cost for operating all machines during normal operating hours

OvertimeCost.definition: Extra cost for operating a machine in overtime per hour

OvertimeHour.definition: Number of overtime hours available for machine m
